name: Arcane Armor Mastery
summary: Reduce arcane spell failure from armor by an additional 20%.

name: Arcane Armor Training
summary: As a swift action, reduce arcane spell failure from armor by 10% for 1 round.

name: Arcane Strike

effects.name: Arcane Strike
effects.effect: Weapons gain +1 damage (+1 per 5 CL, max +5) and count as magic for overcoming DR. Lasts 1 round.

summary: Swift action to add CL-based bonus damage to weapons and bypass magic DR.

name: Bleeding Critical

effects.effect: Target takes 2d6 bleed damage per round.

summary: On confirmed critical, target takes 2d6 bleed damage each round.

name: Blind-Fight

effects.description: Reroll miss chance from concealment once per attack. Invisible attackers get no bonus to hit you in melee. Not flat-footed against unseen melee attackers.

summary: Reroll concealment miss chance. Not flat-footed vs invisible melee attackers.

name: Blinding Critical

effects.effect: Target is permanently blinded.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is permanently blinded (Fort negates).

name: Catch Off-Guard

effects.description: No penalty for using improvised melee weapons.
Unarmed opponents are flat-footed against your improvised weapon attacks.

summary: No improvised melee penalty. Unarmed foes flat-footed to your improvised attacks.

name: Channel Smite

effects.name: Channel Smite
effects.effect: Channel energy through melee attack. On hit, deal channel energy damage (Will save for half). On miss, channel energy is wasted.

summary: Channel energy through a melee weapon strike as a swift action.

name: Cleave

effects.name: Cleave
effects.effect: On melee hit, make additional attack against adjacent foe at same bonus. Take -2 to AC until next turn.

summary: Standard action: on melee hit, one extra attack vs adjacent foe at -2 AC.

name: Combat Expertise
summary: Trade attack bonus for dodge AC. -1 attack/+1 AC, scaling every 4 BAB.

name: Combat Reflexes

effects.description: May make AoOs while flat-footed.

summary: Additional AoOs per round equal to DEX modifier. May AoO while flat-footed.

name: Critical Focus
summary: +4 bonus on rolls to confirm critical hits.

name: Critical Mastery

effects.description: Apply two critical feat effects simultaneously on a confirmed critical hit.

summary: Apply two critical feat effects on a single confirmed critical.

name: Dazzling Display

effects.name: Dazzling Display
effects.effect: Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 ft who can see your weapon display.

summary: Full-round action: Intimidate all visible foes within 30 ft.

name: Deadly Aim
summary: Trade ranged attack bonus for damage. -1 attack/+2 damage, scaling every 4 BAB.

name: Deafening Critical

effects.effect: Target is permanently deafened.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is permanently deafened (Fort negates).

name: Deflect Arrows
summary: Deflect one ranged attack per round when you have a free hand.

name: Disruptive

effects.description: Increase DC of concentration checks for enemies casting defensively within your threatened area by +4.

summary: Enemies in your threatened area have +4 DC to cast defensively.

name: Dodge
summary: +1 dodge bonus to AC.

name: Double Slice
summary: Add full STR modifier to off-hand damage (instead of half).

name: Exhausting Critical

effects.effect: Target is exhausted.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is exhausted.

name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
summary: Gain proficiency with one exotic weapon.

name: Far Shot

effects.description: Reduce ranged penalties: -1 per range increment (projectile) or -1 per 2 increments (thrown) instead of normal -2.

summary: Reduce range increment penalties for ranged weapons.

name: Gorgon's Fist

effects.name: Gorgon's Fist
effects.effect: Unarmed strike against dazed, flat-footed, or stunned foe. On hit, target is staggered until end of your next turn (Fort DC 10 + 1/2 level + WIS mod negates).

summary: Unarmed strike vs impaired foe can stagger (Fort negates).

name: Great Cleave

effects.name: Great Cleave
effects.effect: As Cleave, but no limit on number of extra attacks as long as each target is adjacent to the previous.

summary: Cleave with unlimited extra attacks against adjacent foes.

name: Greater Bull Rush

effects.additionalEffect: Targets of your bull rush provoke AoOs from your allies.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for bull rush. Bull rushed targets provoke AoO.

name: Greater Disarm

effects.additionalEffect: Disarmed weapon lands 15 ft away in random direction.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for disarm. Disarmed weapon is flung 15 ft away.

name: Greater Feint

effects.description: When you successfully feint, target loses DEX bonus to AC against all attacks until start of your next turn (not just your next attack).

summary: Successful feint makes target lose DEX to AC vs all attacks until your next turn.

name: Greater Grapple

effects.additionalEffect: Maintain grapple as a move action instead of standard.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for grapple. Maintain grapple as move action.

name: Greater Overrun

effects.additionalEffect: Targets of your overrun provoke AoOs from your allies when knocked prone.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for overrun. Overrun targets provoke AoO when knocked prone.

name: Greater Penetrating Strike
summary: Ignore up to 10 points of DR with focused weapon (except DR/—).

name: Greater Shield Focus
summary: +1 additional shield bonus to AC.

name: Greater Sunder

effects.additionalEffect: Excess damage from sunder applies to the item wielder.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for sunder. Excess damage transfers to wielder.

name: Greater Trip

effects.additionalEffect: Tripped targets provoke AoOs from you and your allies.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for trip. Tripped targets provoke AoO.

name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
summary: Gain a third off-hand attack at -10 penalty.

name: Greater Vital Strike
summary: Roll weapon damage dice 4 times on a single attack (3 extra).

name: Greater Weapon Focus
summary: +1 additional attack bonus with chosen weapon.

name: Greater Weapon Specialization
summary: +2 additional damage with chosen weapon.

name: Improved Bull Rush
summary: +2 CMB/CMD for bull rush. Does not provoke AoO.

name: Improved Critical
summary: Double the critical threat range of chosen weapon.

name: Improved Disarm
summary: +2 CMB/CMD for disarm. Does not provoke AoO.

name: Improved Feint

effects.description: Can feint in combat as a move action instead of a standard action.

summary: Feint as a move action instead of standard.

name: Improved Grapple
summary: +2 CMB/CMD for grapple. Does not provoke AoO.

name: Improved Initiative
summary: +4 bonus to initiative.

name: Improved Overrun

effects.description: Targets of your overrun cannot choose to avoid you.

summary: +2 CMB/CMD for overrun. Does not provoke AoO. Foes cannot avoid.

name: Improved Precise Shot

effects.description: Ranged attacks ignore anything less than total cover and anything less than total concealment.

summary: Ranged attacks ignore less-than-total cover and concealment.

name: Improved Shield Bash

effects.description: Retain shield bonus to AC when making a shield bash attack.

summary: Keep shield AC bonus when shield bashing.

name: Improved Sunder
summary: +2 CMB/CMD for sunder. Does not provoke AoO.

name: Improved Trip
summary: +2 CMB/CMD for trip. Does not provoke AoO.

name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
summary: Gain a second off-hand attack at -5 penalty.

name: Improved Unarmed Strike

effects.description: Unarmed attacks do not provoke AoOs. May deal lethal or nonlethal damage with unarmed strikes.

summary: Unarmed strikes do not provoke AoO. Deal lethal or nonlethal.

name: Improved Vital Strike
summary: Roll weapon damage dice 3 times on a single attack (2 extra).

name: Improvised Weapon Mastery

effects.description: Improvised weapons deal damage one size larger. Critical threat range is 19-20. Do not provoke AoOs with improvised weapons.

summary: Improvised weapons deal increased damage, crit on 19-20.

name: Lightning Stance

effects.condition: when you take two or more actions to move in a round

summary: 50% miss chance against you after taking two move actions in a round.

name: Lunge

effects.description: Increase melee reach by 5 ft until end of turn at the cost of -2 to AC until start of next turn.

summary: +5 ft melee reach until end of turn, -2 AC until next turn.

name: Manyshot

effects.description: Fire two arrows on your first ranged attack at full BAB. Both use the same attack roll; damage for each is calculated separately.

summary: Fire two arrows on first attack of a full-attack action.

name: Mobility
summary: +4 dodge AC against AoOs caused by movement.

name: Mounted Archery

effects.description: Ranged attack penalties while mounted are halved (-2 at a walk or hustle, -4 at a gallop).

summary: Halve ranged attack penalties while mounted.

name: Mounted Combat

effects.description: Once per round, negate a hit on your mount by making a Ride check (DC = attack roll result).

summary: Negate one hit on mount per round with a Ride check.

name: Penetrating Strike
summary: Ignore up to 5 points of DR with focused weapon (except DR/—).

name: Pinpoint Targeting

effects.name: Pinpoint Targeting
effects.effect: Make a single ranged attack that resolves against touch AC instead of normal AC.

summary: Standard action: single ranged attack vs touch AC.

name: Point-Blank Shot
summary: +1 attack and +1 damage on ranged attacks within 30 ft.

name: Power Attack
summary: Trade melee attack for damage. -1 attack/+2 damage (+3 two-handed), scaling every 4 BAB.

name: Precise Shot

effects.description: No -4 penalty for shooting or throwing into melee.

summary: No penalty for shooting into melee.

name: Rapid Reload

effects.description: Reload chosen crossbow or firearm faster: light crossbow/hand crossbow as free action; heavy crossbow as move action.

summary: Reload a crossbow faster (light=free, heavy=move action).

name: Rapid Shot

effects.condition: all attacks in a full-attack take -2

summary: One extra ranged attack at highest BAB in full attack; all attacks at -2.

name: Ride-By Attack

effects.description: When mounted and charging, move before and after the attack. Total distance cannot exceed mount speed.

summary: Move before and after a mounted charge attack.

name: Scorpion Style

effects.name: Scorpion Style
effects.effect: Unarmed strike; on hit target speed reduced to 5 ft for a number of rounds equal to your WIS modifier (Fort DC 10 + 1/2 level + WIS mod negates).

summary: Unarmed strike reduces target speed to 5 ft (Fort negates).

name: Shatter Defenses

effects.description: Any shaken, frightened, or panicked foe you hit is flat-footed to your attacks until the end of your next turn.

summary: Shaken/frightened foes you hit become flat-footed to your attacks.

name: Shield Focus
summary: +1 shield bonus to AC.

name: Shield Master

effects.description: No TWF penalty when using a shield as off-hand weapon.
Add shield enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the shield.

summary: No TWF penalty with shield. Add shield enhancement to attack/damage.

name: Shield Slam

effects.description: On shield bash hit during a full attack, free bull rush (does not provoke AoO). If bull rush pushes into wall or obstacle, target takes additional 1d6+STR damage.

summary: Free bull rush on shield bash hit; extra damage if pushed into wall.

name: Shot on the Run

effects.description: Move before and after a ranged attack. Total distance cannot exceed speed.

summary: Move before and after a single ranged attack.

name: Sickening Critical

effects.effect: Target is sickened for 1 minute.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is sickened for 1 minute (Fort negates).

name: Snatch Arrows

effects.description: When you deflect a ranged attack, you catch it. You may throw it back as a free action at the original attacker.

summary: Catch deflected arrows and throw them back as a free action.

name: Spellbreaker

effects.description: Enemies in your threatened area that fail concentration checks for casting defensively provoke an AoO from you.

summary: Foes who fail defensive casting in your reach provoke AoO.

name: Spirited Charge
summary: Double damage on mounted charge (triple with lance).

name: Spring Attack

effects.description: Move before and after a melee attack. Target does not get AoO. Total distance cannot exceed speed.

summary: Move before and after a melee attack without provoking AoO from target.

name: Staggering Critical

effects.effect: Target is staggered for 1d4+1 rounds.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is staggered for 1d4+1 rounds (Fort negates).

name: Step Up

effects.description: When an adjacent foe takes a 5-ft step away from you, you may take an immediate 5-ft step to follow.

summary: Take an immediate 5-ft step when an adjacent foe 5-ft steps away.

name: Stunning Critical

effects.effect: Target is stunned for 1d4 rounds.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is stunned for 1d4 rounds (Fort negates).

name: Stunning Fist

effects.name: Stunning Fist
effects.effect: Declare before unarmed attack. On hit, target is stunned for 1 round.

summary: Unarmed strike can stun (Fort negates). Uses/day = level/4 (min 1).

name: Throw Anything

effects.description: No penalty for using improvised thrown weapons.

summary: No improvised thrown penalty. +1 damage with splash weapons.

name: Tiring Critical

effects.effect: Target is fatigued.

summary: On confirmed critical, target is fatigued.

name: Trample

effects.description: When mounted, you can overrun as part of a charge. Targets that fail to avoid take hoof damage and you can make your attack at any point during the overrun.

summary: Overrun as part of mounted charge. Targets take hoof damage.

name: Two-Weapon Defense

effects.condition: when wielding two weapons (or weapon and shield) and fighting defensively or using total defense

summary: +1 shield bonus to AC when fighting with two weapons.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
summary: Reduce TWF penalties: -2 main / -2 off-hand (with light off-hand).

name: Two-Weapon Rend

effects.description: When you hit with both main and off-hand weapons in the same round, deal an extra 1d10 + 1.5 × STR modifier damage.

summary: Extra 1d10 + 1.5×STR damage when hitting with both weapons.

name: Unseat

effects.description: On a mounted charge with a lance, attempt a bull rush instead of a normal attack. If successful, target is knocked from saddle.

summary: Mounted lance charge can unhorse opponent via bull rush.

name: Vital Strike
summary: Roll weapon damage dice 2 times on a single attack (1 extra).

name: Weapon Finesse

effects.forRoll: melee attack rolls with light or finesse weapons

summary: Use DEX instead of STR for attack rolls with light/finesse weapons.

name: Weapon Focus
summary: +1 attack with chosen weapon.

name: Weapon Specialization
summary: +2 damage with chosen weapon.

name: Whirlwind Attack

effects.name: Whirlwind Attack
effects.effect: Make one melee attack at full BAB against each opponent within reach.

summary: Full-round: one melee attack against each foe within reach.

name: Wind Stance

effects.condition: when you move more than 5 ft in a round

summary: 20% miss chance against you after moving more than 5 ft in a round.

name: Acrobatic
summary: +2 Acrobatics and Fly (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Acrobatic Steps

effects.description: Move through up to 15 ft of difficult terrain per round as if it were normal terrain.

summary: Ignore up to 15 ft of difficult terrain per round.

name: Alertness
summary: +2 Perception and Sense Motive (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Animal Affinity
summary: +2 Handle Animal and Ride (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Armor Proficiency (Light)
summary: No armor check penalty on attack rolls while wearing light armor.

name: Armor Proficiency (Medium)
summary: No armor check penalty on attack rolls while wearing medium armor.

name: Armor Proficiency (Heavy)
summary: No armor check penalty on attack rolls while wearing heavy armor.

name: Athletic
summary: +2 Climb and Swim (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Augment Summoning
summary: Summoned creatures gain +4 STR and +4 CON.

name: Combat Casting
summary: +4 to concentration checks for casting defensively or while grappled.

name: Deceitful
summary: +2 Bluff and Disguise (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Deft Hands
summary: +2 Disable Device and Sleight of Hand (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Diehard

effects.description: Automatically stabilize when reduced to negative HP. Can choose to act while at negative HP (staggered), taking 1 HP damage per round of activity.

summary: Auto-stabilize at negative HP. Can act while disabled (staggered).

name: Endurance

effects.condition: vs hot/cold environments, suffocation, or forced march

effects.description: May sleep in light or medium armor without becoming fatigued.

summary: +4 on checks to avoid nonlethal from environment. Sleep in medium armor.

name: Eschew Materials

effects.description: Cast any spell with a material component costing 1 gp or less without needing that component.

summary: Cast spells without material components worth 1 gp or less.

name: Extra Channel
summary: Channel energy 2 additional times per day.

name: Fleet

effects.condition: when wearing light or no armor

summary: +5 ft base speed (light or no armor). Can be taken multiple times.

name: Great Fortitude
summary: +2 to Fortitude saves.

name: Improved Great Fortitude
summary: Reroll one Fortitude save per day. Must take second result.

name: Improved Iron Will
summary: Reroll one Will save per day. Must take second result.

name: Improved Lightning Reflexes
summary: Reroll one Reflex save per day. Must take second result.

name: Iron Will
summary: +2 to Will saves.

name: Leadership

effects.description: Gain a cohort (level = yours - 2) and followers based on Leadership score (character level + CHA modifier + modifiers).

summary: Attract a cohort and followers based on Leadership score.

name: Lightning Reflexes
summary: +2 to Reflex saves.

name: Magical Aptitude
summary: +2 Spellcraft and Use Magic Device (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
summary: Gain proficiency with one martial weapon.

name: Natural Spell

effects.description: Cast spells while in wild shape form. Substitute various material components with equivalents of the form.

summary: Cast spells while using wild shape.

name: Nimble Moves

effects.description: Move through 5 ft of difficult terrain per round as if it were normal terrain.

summary: Ignore 5 ft of difficult terrain per round.

name: Persuasive
summary: +2 Diplomacy and Intimidate (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Run

effects.description: Run at 5x speed (instead of 4x). +4 to Acrobatics checks for running jumps. Retain DEX bonus to AC while running.

summary: Run at 5x speed. +4 running jumps. Keep DEX bonus to AC while running.

name: Self-Sufficient
summary: +2 Heal and Survival (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Shield Proficiency
summary: No armor check penalty on attack rolls while using a shield.

name: Simple Weapon Proficiency
summary: Gain proficiency with all simple weapons.

name: Skill Focus
summary: +3 to chosen skill (+6 at 10+ ranks).

name: Spell Focus
summary: +1 to save DCs of spells from chosen school.

name: Spell Focus (Conjuration)
summary: +1 to save DCs of conjuration spells. (Specific instance for Augment Summoning prerequisite.)

name: Greater Spell Focus
summary: +1 additional to save DCs of spells from chosen school (stacks with Spell Focus).

name: Spell Penetration
summary: +2 on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Greater Spell Penetration
summary: +2 additional on caster level checks to overcome SR (stacks with Spell Penetration).

name: Stealthy
summary: +2 Escape Artist and Stealth (+4 at 10+ ranks each).

name: Toughness
summary: +1 HP per level (minimum +3 HP).

name: Tower Shield Proficiency
summary: No armor check penalty on attack rolls while using a tower shield.

name: Turn Undead

effects.description: Channel positive energy to cause undead to flee (as the panicked condition) for 1 minute. Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 cleric level + CHA mod) negates.

summary: Channel positive energy to make undead flee (Will negates).

name: Empower Spell

effects.effect: All variable numeric effects of the spell are increased by half (+50%).

summary: +2 spell level: increase variable numeric effects by 50%.

name: Enlarge Spell

effects.effect: Double the range of the spell.

summary: +1 spell level: double the range.

name: Extend Spell

effects.effect: Double the duration of the spell.

summary: +1 spell level: double the duration.

name: Heighten Spell

effects.effect: Cast the spell at a higher spell level. All level-dependent variables (including save DC) use the heightened level. Level increase is variable (chosen at casting).

summary: Cast spell at a higher level. Save DCs and effects use the new level.

name: Maximize Spell

effects.effect: All variable numeric effects of the spell are maximized.

summary: +3 spell level: maximize all variable numeric effects.

name: Quicken Spell

effects.effect: Cast the spell as a swift action instead of its normal casting time.

summary: +4 spell level: cast as a swift action.

name: Silent Spell

effects.effect: Cast the spell without verbal components.

summary: +1 spell level: remove verbal component.

name: Still Spell

effects.effect: Cast the spell without somatic components.

summary: +1 spell level: remove somatic component.

name: Widen Spell

effects.effect: Double the area of a burst, emanation, line, or spread spell.

summary: +3 spell level: double the area.

name: Brew Potion
summary: Create potions of any spell of 3rd level or lower that targets a creature.

name: Craft Magic Arms and Armor
summary: Create magic weapons, armor, and shields.

name: Craft Rod
summary: Create magic rods.

name: Craft Staff
summary: Create magic staves.

name: Craft Wand
summary: Create wands of any spell of 4th level or lower.

name: Craft Wondrous Item
summary: Create miscellaneous wondrous items.

name: Forge Ring
summary: Create magic rings.

name: Scribe Scroll
summary: Create scrolls of any spell you know or have prepared.
